summary: This video covers the final quiz redemption code EQUINOXIAL for 15 Heliolite Dice in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Creator Suzi Plays discusses her upcoming summoning strategy for the Option Summons banner, choosing between Thunderbolt/Dauntless vs. Toxin supports. She also reviews her progress in the Strategy Challenge (Magic Chess) dojos, having maxed out the Toxic/Aura track.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Her exclusive artifact is amazing, making her a top target for Toxin team setups.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Available as a new Thunderbolt damage dealer in the Option Summons pool.

heroes.note: Can be acquired from the shop using hero fragments.

tips: Selecting specific elemental schools on the Option Summons banner shrinks the hero pool, increasing your odds of getting desired heroes like Maashtur, Irmoush, or Selva.
Progressing through all Strategy Challenge (Magic Chess) dojo rewards gives valuable milestone items even if you don't enjoy the mode.
